title: Interview the people
subtitle: who made history
description: Pick a character from Wikipedia and talk to them in class: scientists, artists, explorers, philosophers. Ask questions, challenge their answers, try to change their mind. At the end you get feedback on your reasoning.

messages.s1: Hi Galileo! Can I really interview you?
messages.g1: Of course! Pick anyone from Wikipedia and I'll answer as them, with what we know about their life.
messages.s2: So tell me: why did you point your telescope at the sky?
messages.g2: I wanted to see for myself. And I found four moons circling Jupiter!
messages.s3: Are you sure? Many people back then didn't believe you.
messages.g3: Great objection! Here we reason with evidence: copying an answer isn't enough.
messages.s4: And what happens at the end?
messages.g4: You write what you learned and get feedback on your reasoning. Ready to try?
